equity_bridge.note: H1 2026 balance sheet: $31m current + $28m non-current (CTEC.L_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:1382, 1389). Debt-like; FY2025 paid $27m of earn-outs.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-1.9%) diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (5.2-5.6%) and EPS (9.0% 5yr) because distributions exceed retained earnings: $326m of buybacks in FY2025, dividends of $140m, and $141m of non-cash InnovaMatrix impairments shrank book equity from $1,689m to $1,429m. Equity CAGR is therefore not a usable growth proxy here; revenue CAGR plus guidance is used.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC; interest income not stripped, net borrower): FY2020 $300.9m, FY2021 $195.4m, FY2022 $120.8m, FY2023 $223.6m, FY2024 $254.3m, FY2025 $257.0m. The 3-year figure (28.6%) is off the FY2022 trough (hospital-care exit, inflation, $144m capex) and the 5-year figure (-3.1%) is off the FY2020 Covid working-capital peak; neither is a trend. Owner-FCF CAGR is 1.1pp below reported FCF CAGR on 3 years, i.e. SBC has grown faster than cash flow ($12.4m -> $28m) but from a low base (1.15% of revenue). EPS 3yr (40.5%) is off the impairment-depressed FY2022 base; adjusted diluted EPS grew 16% in FY2025 to 17.6c.

scenario_narratives.base: Chronic-care consumables (>90% of revenue recurring) grow at the bottom of the Accelerate 6-8% range in FY2027-28 after a 5% FY2026 held back by the 2.5pp InnovaMatrix headwind, then fade to 2.5%. The adjusted operating margin reaches c.25% by 2030 (midpoint of the 24-26% target) as CBS shared services and automation offset tariffs and FX. Capex normalises from $215m in FY2026 to 5% of revenue once the 2026-28 capacity programme completes, and the cash tax rate rises from 17% to 23% as the BMS-era acquired-intangible tax amortisation expires mid-2026. Leverage returns to 2.0x.
scenario_narratives.bull: Wave-2 launches and non-diabetes Infusion Care (Parkinson's via AbbVie, Supernus) deliver 7-7.5% organic growth in FY2027-28, margins reach c.26.5%, the Warning Letter closes without disruption, and competitive bidding favours scale incumbents. Terminal growth 3.0%, cap 20x.
scenario_narratives.bear: A second reimbursement shock (DMEPOS competitive bidding, GPO pricing) and an escalated Unomedical FDA matter hold growth at 3-4% with margins stalled at c.23%; growth capex already committed is under-utilised, so capex stays at 6% of revenue. Terminal growth 1.5%, cap 15x.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value a defensive, recurring-revenue consumables manufacturer on unlevered owner FCF with SBC expensed, leases charged in the flows, the expiring acquired-intangible tax shelter ramped out, and capex normalised after the current capacity build. Risk is charged once, in the bear flows and a 25% bear weight, not in the discount rate. Per-share values are computed in USD and converted to pence at a dated GBPUSD rate, so the headline IV is comparable to the LSE quote.
key_risks_to_valuation: US CMS reimbursement policy: InnovaMatrix lost >90% of revenue on one payment-rate decision; DMEPOS competitive bidding for ostomy/continence (1-2% of group sales) is pending for 2028 or later
FDA Warning Letter (January 2026) at Unomedical, Reynosa, a sole-source Infusion Care plant supplying MiniMed, Tandem and Beta Bionics as well as Convatec's own sets
Growth capex supercycle ($200-230m FY2026) assumed to settle at 5-6% of revenue from 2028; if it does not, the terminal FCF margin is c.1-2pp lower
Cash tax: the model assumes the acquired-intangible deduction expires and the cash rate converges on the 23% book rate; a persistently lower cash rate would be upside
FX: USD flows against a GBp quote; a 5% move in GBPUSD moves the pence IV 5% with no change in the business
Leverage 2.3x at H1 2026 with a further $200m debt-funded buyback; the model does not re-lever for it (value-neutral near IV) but headroom for another shock is thinner
Terminal value is capped at 18x FCF in the base case (Gordon at 8%/2.5% would be 18.6x); the cap, not Gordon, binds

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (CTEC.L, LSE, GBp) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 193.0-259.3 GBp. FX from Yahoo GBPUSD=X on the valuation date; ADR CNVVY used for the parity check.
data_sources.financials: CTEC.L_Metrics.csv (USD millions, FY2017-FY2025 and H1 periods to H1 FY2026); FY2025 Annual Report (adjusted-earnings reconciliation, cash flow statement, lease and tax notes); H1 2026 interim report (balance sheet, diluted shares, contingent consideration, FY2026 guidance).
data_sources.qualitative: CTEC.L_Analysis.json (2026-10-10): Accelerate strategy targets, InnovaMatrix/CMS, Unomedical FDA Warning Letter, DMEPOS competitive bidding, capex and leverage guidance.

sanity_check_agent_review.verdict: passed (genuine on EV/EBITDA and P/Sales; P/B marginal) -- but the script's pass is a false pass via the known sanity_check.py fx_rate direction bug
sanity_check_agent_review.bug_note: scripts/sanity_check.py multiplies the GBp price by inputs.fx_rate (75.569) instead of dividing, so the printed implied multiples are 75.6x too high and the historical table is 75.6^2 = 5,711x too high (P/B 24,638x for FY2025 is 4.3x). Same false-pass family as HSBC, AAF.L, BAB.L in memory. Nothing tripped, so no Step 8c.5 fix was applied; the true multiples below were recomputed by hand and would not trip the EV/EBITDA or P/Sales rules.

implied_multiples_true.basis: weighted IV 253.08 GBp = USD 3.349/share x 1,960.4m diluted shares = equity $6,565m; EV = equity + net debt $1,534m + contingent consideration $59m = $8,158m; FY2025 denominators

sanity_check_agent_review.reading: At the weighted IV the stock would trade on EV/EBITDA and P/Sales equal to its own 2020-25 average and 7% above its historical P/B maximum; the P/B excess is a denominator effect (book equity fell from $1,689m to $1,429m on $326m of buybacks and $141m of InnovaMatrix impairments), not a re-rating assumption. The current price sits at the bottom third of the historical EV/EBITDA range.

inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted average ordinary shares for H1 2026 (1,960,354,993; CTEC.L_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:1092), net of the 102.7m shares bought into treasury in 2025. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would charge grant dilution twice. The $200m H2-2026 buyback (c.3.5% of the count at the current price) is not modelled: it is debt-funded, so it moves shares and net debt together and is value-neutral at prices near intrinsic value. The Metrics CSV's 2,000m figure is a net-income/EPS approximation; the filing's diluted figure is used here.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 consolidated cash flow statement, share-based payments add-back $28m (CTEC.L_Annual_FY2025.txt:11518); equity-award taxes disclosed as nil. The adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation shows $24m; the cash-flow figure is used as the fuller charge.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows are USD (FY2025 annual report headers, '$m'); the LSE quote is in pence sterling (GBp = 1/100 GBP). fx_rate converts USD per share to GBp: 100 / GBPUSD 1.3233 (Yahoo GBPUSD=X, 2026-10-10) = 75.569 GBp per USD. Parity check: the OTC ADR CNVVY (1 ADR = 4 ordinary shares, Yahoo, 2026-10-09) divided by 4 ties to the LSE quote converted at this rate within 0.1%, confirming the direction and the pence basis. Note refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate; re-derive the rate when the price is refreshed.
inputs.net_debt_basis: H1 2026 balance sheet: borrowings $1,626m less cash $92m = $1,534m, the company's own 'net debt excluding lease liabilities' (CTEC.L_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:858-861, 1177-1180). Lease liabilities of $115m are excluded because the lease cash cost is charged in the flows (see lease_treatment). Leverage 2.3x adjusted EBITDA at 30 June, guided back to c.2.0x by December 2026.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, so a USD-built rate: US 10-year c.4.1% + 5.0% ERP x beta c.0.95 (defensive chronic-care consumables but 2x levered) gives a cost of equity of c.9%; after-tax cost of debt c.3.8% (FY2026 adjusted net finance expense guidance $70-75m on c.$1.6bn gross debt, 23% tax); market weights c.78% equity / 22% debt at the current price give 7.9%, rounded to 8.0%. The same WACC is used in all three scenarios: InnovaMatrix-type reimbursement risk, the FDA Warning Letter and leverage are charged in the bear flows and the bear weight, not in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: the full IFRS-16 lease cash cost (FY2025 principal $27m in financing, CTEC.L_Annual_FY2025.txt:11580, plus interest on leases $5m, :14145 = $32m = 1.3% of revenue) is deducted inside the flows via lease_cost_pct_path, and lease liabilities ($115m at H1 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt. da_pct_path is therefore depreciation of PP&E ($43m) plus amortisation of non-acquired intangibles ($155m - $134m acquired = $21m), i.e. ex right-of-use depreciation ($26m) and ex acquired-intangible amortisation, so the lease is charged once and the cash-tax EBIT is not double-hit.
inputs.nci_treatment: None required: no material non-controlling interests; net profit is fully attributable.
inputs.ebitda_definition: ebitda_margin_path is the company's adjusted EBITDA (FY2025 $661m = 27.1% of revenue; pre-SBC, post-IFRS-16, before acquired-intangible amortisation and impairments, CTEC.L_Annual_FY2025.txt:2369) LESS the recurring cash 'adjusting items' (restructuring, termination, acquisition costs: $16m FY2025, $22m FY2024, $18m H1 2026 = c.0.7% of revenue), giving a cash EBITDA margin of 26.4% for FY2025. SBC (1.15%) and the lease cash cost (1.3%) are then charged as their own lines. Cross-check: FY2025 modelled EBIT on this basis = 2,439 x (26.4 - 1.15 - 1.3 - 2.6)% = $522m vs adjusted operating profit $544m less adjusting items $16m less the lease-cost/ROU-depreciation gap $6m = $522m.
inputs.cash_tax_basis: FY2025 cash taxes paid $54m were only c.11% of adjusted PBT ($471m) because the amortisation of acquired intangibles ($134m, $95m of it from the 2008 BMS spin-out, fully amortised by mid-2026) is tax-deductible (tax effect $32m) and other timing. H1 2026 cash tax jumped to $47m (H1 2025: $25m). The cash rate on unlevered EBIT is ramped 17% (FY2026) -> 20% -> 22% -> 23% (guided adjusted book rate c.23%) so the expiring shelter is not perpetuated. Interest is not deducted in the flows; its tax shield lives in the after-tax cost of debt inside WACC.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF on the component engine (make build-dcf), probability-weighted, 10-year explicit horizon FY2026-FY2035 because capex is in a growth supercycle (8.4% of revenue in FY2026 guided to settle at 5-7% from 2028) and margins are still ramping to the 24-26% Accelerate target, so a 5-year terminal would capitalise an immature margin. Routing: standard operating company (chronic-care medical consumables manufacturer) -> owner-fcf.md plus owner-fcf-adaptations.md for the USD/GBp currency split, IFRS-16 leases and non-US WACC. last_fcf is owner FCF = reported FCF 285 - SBC 28 - interest income 0 = 257; interest income (finance income $3m) is NOT stripped because the company is a net borrower (the strip applies only when net cash exceeds the FCF base). Reported FCF is after interest paid ($82m, classified in operating activities under IFRS), so last_fcf is a levered anchor for display and CAGRs; the engine's projections are unlevered and the debt is deducted once in the bridge. Buybacks: a repurchaser ($326m FY2025, $200m more announced for H2 2026), so the flat count is funded. Price is a regular-session LSE close, not after-hours. The $59m contingent consideration (earn-outs) is deducted in equity_bridge as debt-like. Impairments ($72m FY2025, $69m H1 2026, InnovaMatrix) are non-cash and excluded.
inputs.sanity_multiples_note: Lease-consistent multiples: ex-lease EV against adjusted EBITDA less lease cash ($661m - $32m = $629m), or lease-inclusive EV against the post-IFRS-16 $661m. Reported P/E is distorted by $134m/yr acquired-intangible amortisation and $141m of InnovaMatrix impairments; adjusted diluted EPS FY2025 was 17.6c (reported 8.6c).

bear.narrative: The InnovaMatrix pattern repeats: a second reimbursement shock (DMEPOS competitive bidding for ostomy and continence from 2028, 1-2% of group sales; GPO pricing pressure) holds organic growth at 3-4% and the capacity built for 6-8% is under-utilised, so capex stays at 6%+ of revenue without the growth; the Unomedical FDA Warning Letter escalates into remediation costs and partner (MiniMed, Tandem) supply caution that stalls Infusion Care; the adjusted operating margin stalls at c.23% as tariffs, FX and remediation absorb the CBS savings; leverage stays above the 2.0x target after the debt-funded $500m of buybacks, so the terminal multiple is capped at 15x.

base.growth_note: FY2026: H1 reported +4.4%; H2 guided 6-8% organic ex-InnovaMatrix less c.1.8pp InnovaMatrix headwind plus c.1.3pp FX tailwind at H1 spot -> c.5% for the year (FY26 guidance 5.5-6.5% ex-InnovaMatrix, 2.5pp InnovaMatrix headwind, FX tailwind). FY2027-28 at 6.0%, the bottom of the 6-8% Accelerate range (the company's own five-year record is the 5-7% band, and wave-2 launches must deliver), then a 0.5pp/yr fade to the 2.5% terminal rate.
base.ebitda_margin_note: Cash adjusted-EBITDA margin (see inputs.ebitda_definition; FY2025 = 26.4%). FY2026 27.0% = guided adjusted operating margin >=23.0% + D&A ex-acquired c.3.8% + SBC 1.1% - adjusting items 0.7%. Ramps to 29.5% by FY2030, equivalent to an adjusted operating margin of c.25%, the midpoint of the 24-26% Accelerate target, net of the rising depreciation from the growth capex. Flat thereafter.
base.da_note: Ex right-of-use depreciation and ex acquired-intangible amortisation (FY2025: $43m PP&E + $21m non-acquired intangibles = 2.6%). Rises as $200m+/yr of growth capex enters service, converging on capex less a c.0.7pp net-investment gap consistent with 2.5% terminal growth on c.25% net fixed-asset intensity.
base.capex_note: FY2026 guidance $200-230m (midpoint 8.4% of revenue; H1 already $128m), operational capex c.2.5% plus growth capex $135-165m. Management expects capex to settle at 5-7% of revenue from 2028; the path takes 6.0% in FY2028-29 (midpoint) easing to 5.0% once the capacity programme (c.20% network expansion by 2028) is complete.
base.wc_note: Manufacturer with receivables + inventory > payables: growth consumes cash. FY2025 working-capital outflow $40m on a $150m revenue increase (-27%); FY2024 +$7m; -15% is the through-cycle capture.
base.narrative: Accelerate delivers at the bottom of its range: 6% organic growth in FY2027-28 fading to 2.5%, adjusted operating margin reaching c.25% by 2030, capex normalising to 5-6% of revenue after the 2026-28 capacity build, and the acquired-intangible tax shelter expiring so cash tax rises to 23%.

bull.narrative: Accelerate delivers at the top of its range: wave-2 launches (ConvaNiox, ConvaVAC, ConvaFiber, Natura Body, GentleCath Air) plus double-digit Infusion Care growth on the AbbVie/Supernus non-diabetes therapies and MiniMed/Tandem pump volumes lift organic growth to 7-7.5% in FY2027-28; CBS shared services and manufacturing automation take the adjusted operating margin to c.26.5%, above the 24-26% target; the Unomedical Warning Letter is closed out without supply disruption; the US DMEPOS competitive bidding programme consolidates suppliers in Convatec's favour as a scale incumbent.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because the thesis has a single-regulator dependency (US CMS reimbursement, which zeroed a $69m product line in one decision and has a second programme, DMEPOS competitive bidding, pending for 2028), an open FDA Warning Letter at a sole-source Infusion Care plant, and leverage of 2.3x while $500m of buybacks are debt-funded. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because the bull case needs several independent things to go right at once: growth acceleration above the company's own five-year 5-7% record, margin delivery above the target range, and a clean regulatory outcome. Base at 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
